title.zh-TW: 每推薦一位新用戶，雙方各得 $15
title.en: $15 for you and $15 for each new friend

text.zh-TW: 新用戶下次訂閱享 $15 折扣；推薦人獲得 $15 獎勵存入帳戶。以官方推薦計畫條款為準。
text.en: The new user gets $15 off their next subscription; the referrer gets $15 credited to their account. TradingView's referral program rules apply.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟邀請連結（訂閱頁），註冊或登入 TradingView。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the invite link (the pricing page), then register or log in to TradingView.

steps.zh-TW: 必須是 TradingView 新用戶，並依推薦計畫條款訂閱方案。
steps.en: You must be a new TradingView user and subscribe to a plan under the referral program rules.

steps.zh-TW: 折扣與獎勵依官方條款入帳，詳情見下方「資料來源與條款」。
steps.en: The discount and reward are credited under the official rules; see “Sources and terms” below.

intro.zh-TW: 邀請一位 TradingView 新用戶：對方下次訂閱享 $15 折扣，你也獲得 $15 獎勵存入帳戶。
intro.en: Invite a new TradingView user: they get $15 off their next subscription and you get a $15 reward credited to your account.

description.zh-TW: TradingView 是提供圖表、行情與看盤工具的平台。透過本頁連結前往訂閱頁，新用戶下次訂閱可享 $15 折扣，推薦人也會獲得 $15 獎勵。實際資格、金額與期限以 TradingView 的推薦計畫條款為準。
description.en: TradingView is a platform for charts, market data and analysis tools. Open the pricing page through the link on this page: a new user gets $15 off their next subscription and the referrer receives a $15 reward. Eligibility, amounts and deadlines follow TradingView's referral program rules.

notes.zh-TW: 此連結不含邀請碼，使用連結前往訂閱頁即可。優惠限新用戶，內容與期限以 TradingView 官方推薦計畫條款為準。
notes.en: This link has no separate code; just use it to open the pricing page. The offer is for new users only; TradingView's official referral program rules prevail.
